```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
routes <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    route = case_when(
      !outcome_drafted_d ~ "Undrafted free agent",
      outcome_draft_round_d == 1L ~ "Drafted, round 1",
      outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3 ~ "Drafted, rounds 2 to 3",
      TRUE ~ "Drafted, rounds 4 to 7"
    )
  ) |>
  count(route, name = "n") |>
  mutate(
    share = n / sum(n),
    undrafted = route == "Undrafted free agent",
    route = reorder(route, share)
  )
p <- ggplot(routes, aes(x = 100 * share, y = route)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = undrafted,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s entrants (%.1f%%)", route, fmt(n), 100 * share),
      data_id = route
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", 100 * share, fmt(n))),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#7570B3", `FALSE` = "#1B9E77"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 100) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "NFL entrants by entry route",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Share of NFL entrants from eligible college seasons, %d to %d drafts; undrafted in purple",
      min(risk$draft_year),
      max(risk$draft_year)
    ),
    x = "Share of NFL entrants",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "nfl-entry-routes", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-class
route_class <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(route = if_else(outcome_drafted_d, "Drafted", "Undrafted free agent")) |>
  count(draft_year, route, name = "n") |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
p_class <- ggplot(route_class, aes(draft_year, n, fill = route)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%d class, %s: %s entrants (%.0f%% of the class's entrants)",
        draft_year,
        tolower(route),
        fmt(n),
        100 * share
      ),
      data_id = paste(draft_year, route)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Drafted = "#1B9E77", `Undrafted free agent` = "#7570B3")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(route_class$draft_year), max(route_class$draft_year), 2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NFL entrants by entry route and draft class",
    subtitle = "Drafted and undrafted entrants in each class",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "NFL entrants",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a segment for the count and share."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_class)
```

```{r}
#| label: examples
cast <- running_cast()
risk |>
  filter(playerId %in% cast, outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    player = names(cast)[match(playerId, cast)],
    route = if_else(
      outcome_drafted_d,
      sprintf("Drafted, round %d, pick %d", outcome_draft_round_d, outcome_draft_pick_d),
      "Undrafted free agent"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(draft_year) |>
  select(player, season, draft_year, route) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Player", "Final college season", "Draft class", "Route"),
    caption = "The running examples at their NFL entry."
  )
```
